_comment: How much of each conversation's last message the desktop app's Direct Messages list shows under the person's name (2026-11-03; src/gui/pages/chat/dm_rows.rs). The operator: "I like seeing the snippet but, some people might only want the usernames to display." Each level is the number of lines of the message the row shows (`lines`; 0 is the name alone), with its words and hint (keys in data/i18n/en.json). The person's choice is kept as that number (config.json `dm_preview_lines`), one line unless they choose another (dm_rows.rs DEFAULT_LINES, today's look), so a level added here is offered in Settings > Privacy and the DMs header's cog with no change to the code; a saved number larger than any level here shows as many lines as the largest level does. A preview is also something anyone looking at the screen can read, which is why the words say so. The website's DM list shows names only (web/chat/chat-dms.js renderDmList, its layout since 2026-05-27; docs/FEATURES.md, Unread Indicators), so it has no previews to choose between.
